runtimeRecommendations.recommendation: Map only documented nominal 30 psi for Toro Precision nozzles at Hunter PRS30 or explicit nominal 2.1 bar to their canonical 30 psi table pressure. Apply consistently in defaults, body changes, automatic candidate selection and matched hydraulic keys. Do not treat arbitrary 2.09/2.11 bar or PRS40 as the same setting.
Keep O-series minimumRadiusM=0.75*designated nominal radius, not a per-pressure ratio floor or rNom*.75. O-5-210 and O-12-Q have native 30 psi throws different from their designated model size.
